notes.title: Version 2.1.0 (Switch to Steam Leaderboards for Ranking)
notes.notes:
Due to the termination of the "Nifcloud" service, the ranking function was disabled. We have now switched to using Steam Leaderboards.

Please note that previously registered rankings have been reset.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: "Real-Time Assist Replay Time ～1 min until closing～" released for free today!
notes.notes:
"Honwaka Fuwafuwa" has released its latest game, "Real-time Assist Replay Time: The Last Minute Before Closing," for free today!

It's a mini-game where you can enjoy a score attack-style experience with ultra-fast-paced "ART" slot action. The game features achievements and Steam leaderboards.

In addition, you can enjoy the game with the same characters from their previous works, "HIGH & LOW ~ Aim! 26 consecutive wins! Road to 5,000 trillion yen ~" and "School Sweets Discovery ～granulated sugar edition～"

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2310720/

notes.title: 1st anniversary of release! Update to version 2
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patronage since it was released on Steam on May 11, 2021.
To commemorate the 1st anniversary, we released a new free game and updated this work.
The main contents are as follows.

-Corresponds to the achievements of Steam.
-Implemented character voice.
-Replaced some images of playing cards.
-Fixed the ranking display of the players who arrived at the same time.

Thank you for your continued support.
